definition.name: Authenticated non-root container and persistent restart

steps.name: Authenticate and prepare the released image context
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
container_work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/lsf-container-XXXXXXXX)
echo "CONTAINER_WORK=$container_work" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
mkdir "$container_work/release" "$container_work/trust" "$container_work/tools"
cp -R tools/native_runtime tools/container_runtime "$container_work/tools/"
cp tools/prepare_container_runtime.py "$container_work/tools/"
install -m 0755 "$(command -v gh)" "$container_work/trust/gh"
gh release download 0.1.0-alpha.5 --repo KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric --dir "$container_work/release" --pattern lsf-0.1.0-alpha.5-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz --pattern release.json --pattern SHA256SUMS --pattern SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json --pattern lsf-install.pyz
gh attestation trusted-root > "$container_work/trust/root.jsonl"
python3 "$container_work/tools/prepare_container_runtime.py" --release-directory "$container_work/release" --version 0.1.0-alpha.5 --publisher-policy "$container_work/tools/container_runtime/release-policy.json" --trusted-root "$container_work/trust/root.jsonl" --verifier "$container_work/trust/gh" --output "$container_work/context" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/container-build-inputs.json"

steps.name: Build the runtime and disposable publisher images
steps.run:
docker build --tag lsf-container-runtime "$CONTAINER_WORK/context"
docker build --tag lsf-container-publisher --file tools/static-release/qualification.Dockerfile tools/static-release
docker build --tag lsf-container-operator --file tools/container_runtime/operator-qualification.Dockerfile tools/container_runtime
docker build --tag lsf-trusted-edge --file tools/trusted_edge/Dockerfile .

steps.name: Publish actual signed sites and verify restart
Verify exact HTTPS edge peers and native browser policy
Verify bounded gzip identities and actual native eligibility
steps.run:
docker run --rm --network none --cpus 2 --memory 256m --pids-limit 32 --mount "type=bind,source=$PWD,target=/source,readonly" lsf-container-publisher --test /source/tools/trusted_edge/representation.test.mjs
python3 tools/trusted_edge/qualification.py --image lsf-container-runtime --frontend-image lsf-container-publisher --edge-image lsf-trusted-edge --release-directory "$CONTAINER_WORK/context/release" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/compression-qualification" --compression

with.name: native-container-qualification
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/container-build-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/container-qualification/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/container-qualification/*.jsonl
${{ runner.temp }}/container-qualification/headless-journals/**
${{ runner.temp }}/edge-qualification/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/edge-qualification/*.jsonl
${{ runner.temp }}/compression-qualification/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/compression-qualification/*.jsonl

reviewReason: Lossless sharding of the reviewed v1 inventory; owner fingerprints remain enforced.
